import unittest

class TestWeatherSystem(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_set_city(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.set_city('Beijing')
        self.assertEqual(weatherSystem.city, 'Beijing')

    def test_set_city_with_non_string(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            weatherSystem.set_city(123)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

import unittest

class TestWeatherSystem(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_positive(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.temperature = 27
        result = weatherSystem.celsius_to_fahrenheit()
        self.assertEqual(result, 80.6)

    def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_negative(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.temperature = -10
        result = weatherSystem.celsius_to_fahrenheit()
        self.assertEqual(result, 14.0)

    def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_zero(self):
        weatherSystem = WeatherSystem('New York')
        weatherSystem.temperature = 0
        result = weatherSystem.celsius_to_fahrenheit()
        self.assertEqual(result, 32.0)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
